messages.author: fb9a757632f17914
messages.subject: Help with hierarchical model
parts:
Hi,
I've been using a hierarchical model (model 1 attached) to estimate 23 coefficients based on about 50,000 data points. I have three versions of the model:

Model 1 - first version of the model with observations nested in country. Run for 2000 iterations on 4 chains the model converges with sensible parameter estimates (~2.5 hours).

Model 2 - the same as model 1 but with the 'Matt trick' applied to improve the speed - except it runs more slowly and doesn't quite converge after 2000 iterations. So I guess there is something wrong there.

Model 3 - more complicated model where observations are nested in clusters and clusters nested in countries. So far I have had no success with this version. There are 8000 clusters in the dataset. Some of the clusters only have one observation and there are different numbers of clusters between the countries. It's a lot of parameters to estimate.

Any advice you have on improving the speed in models 2 and 3 would be really great. I am happy I got this far without having to ask a question.

Many thanks,

Sophie
